newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's 2M television to extend domestic coverage.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's 2M television to extend domestic coverage.

text.p: Morocco's state-run 2M television plans to extend coverage to all the country's 27 million people, an official at the communications ministry said on Thursday.

"From next July, the government will gradually build installations throughout the country worth hundreds of millions dirhams to expand 2M television domestic coverage, starting from northern Morocco," the official said.
Set up in late 1980s, 2M now covers only main cities such as Casablanca, Rabat, Kenitra, Marrakesh, Fes and Tangier.

Last year, the government bought 70 percent of the Casablanca-based 2M. The station had losses over several years totalling 455 million dirhams ($52 million). Societe d'Etudes et de Realisations Audiovisuelles (SOREAD) has 30 percent, officials said.
Morocco has a second channel RTM television, based in Rabat and owned 100 percent by the state, covering the whole Moroccan territory including the disputed Western Sahara desert.
